Profile.title: Student Profile
Profile.description: Core student profile identity, age-gate compliance, onboarding state, academic preferences, and 7-language localization.

id.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

avatar_url.description: Optional profile avatar URL from OAuth provider or preset.

language.description: Preferred UI language across 7 supported languages.

grade_level.description: Optional grade level or academic stage.

school_name.description: Optional private school or institution name.

parental_consent.description: Whether parental consent was confirmed for minors 13-17.

onboarded.description: Whether initial onboarding has been completed.

is_anonymous.description: Whether the Firebase Auth user is currently anonymous.

auth_provider.description: Primary Firebase Auth sign-in provider identifier.

email_verified.description: Cached email verification status from Firebase Auth.

phone_number.description: Verified phone number if authenticated or linked via SMS.

gender.description: Private student gender used only to assign Knowledge Circle community.

community_group.description: Locked Knowledge Circle community group derived from private gender.

show_gender_on_profile.description: Optional public visibility flag (defaults to false).

UserSettings.title: User Appearance, Accessibility, Study, AI, Notification, and Privacy Settings
UserSettings.description: Per-student comprehensive personalization, WCAG accessibility, locale, study, AI control, notification, and privacy preferences.

UserStats.title: Growth Map User Stats
UserStats.description: Student XP, level, and consistency streak metrics.

Task.title: Student Task
Task.description: Student productivity task with Growth Area, subject label, subtasks, and recurrence connected to Growth Map progress.

Goal.title: Growth Goal
Goal.description: Student Growth Map and daily focus goal across life areas, with optional daily reset date.

ActivityEvent.title: Growth Activity Event
ActivityEvent.description: Immutable XP and Growth Map milestone log entry per student.

StudyItem.title: Study Material, Flashcard, or Mistake Entry
StudyItem.description: Unified private study record supporting notes, flashcard decks with spaced intervals, and conceptual mistake log entries.

QuizAttempt.title: Study Practice Quiz Attempt
QuizAttempt.description: Immutable practice quiz score history built from the student's study deck.

FocusSession.title: Pomodoro Focus Session
FocusSession.description: Completed deep focus sprint synced with Productivity and Growth Map.

CareEntry.title: Private Wellbeing Check-in & Journal
CareEntry.description: Strictly private student wellbeing reflection. Never shared with peers, moderators, or AI.

FuturePlan.title: Educational & Career Exploration Plan
FuturePlan.description: Personal career interests, strengths, and educational pathway milestones.

Opportunity.title: Student Opportunity Tracker Entry
Opportunity.description: Saved or student-tracked educational opportunity with transparent source metadata.

AiConversation.title: NEXORA AI Saved Conversation
AiConversation.description: Private student AI study conversation history.

CircleTeam.title: Knowledge Circle Study Team
CircleTeam.description: Moderated student collaboration team with non-PII membership.

CircleInvite.title: Knowledge Circle Invite Code Lookup
CircleInvite.description: Non-PII lookup record enabling join-by-exact-code without exposing team directory lists.

CircleMember.title: Knowledge Circle Member
CircleMember.description: Safe non-PII membership record inside a Knowledge Circle team.

CirclePost.title: Knowledge Circle Team Post / Task / Resource
CirclePost.description: Team-scoped question, shared resource, or assigned team task.

member_uids.description: Team member UIDs synced for list queries.

ModerationReport.title: Community Safety & Moderation Report
ModerationReport.description: Logged student safety report for Knowledge Circle or platform content.

HelpArticle.title: Help Center Documentation Article
HelpArticle.description: Searchable help guide and step-by-step documentation authored by NEXORA staff.

SupportTicket.title: Student Support Ticket
SupportTicket.description: Private student support ticket with status tracking and threaded conversation history.

TechnicalReport.title: Technical Bug & Diagnostic Report
TechnicalReport.description: Student-submitted technical bug report with browser context and reproduction steps.

FeedbackItem.title: Student Feature Suggestion & Feedback
FeedbackItem.description: Student suggestion and upvote tracking for platform improvements.

StaffRole.title: Staff RBAC Assignment
StaffRole.description: Authorized staff role assignment managed by platform administrators.

JournalEntry.title: Academic Growth Daily Journal Entry
JournalEntry.description: Private daily academic and personal growth reflection saved to Firestore to complement Growth Map progress tracking.

tags.description: Optional topic tags extracted from reflection or entered manually (max 8).

QuranPreferences.title: QuranPreferences
QuranPreferences.description: Optional user-saved Digital Quran Mushaf reading progress, bookmarks, theme, typography, translation, and listening preferences, keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

bookmarks.description: Bounded private ayah bookmarks and saved reading positions (max 50).

CommunityResource.title: NEXORA Community Library Resource
CommunityResource.description: Structured educational resource with attribution, licensing, and moderation review workflow.

TeachingGuide.title: NEXORA Teaching for All Guide
TeachingGuide.description: Differentiated lesson plan, multi-angle explanation, and worksheet with quality ratings.

RealWorldProject.title: NEXORA Real World Good Project
RealWorldProject.description: Adult-supervised student civic and community service project with zero PII and verifiable milestones.

ContentErrorReport.title: Educational Content Error Report
ContentErrorReport.description: Error, source, or correction report submitted by students or educators.

SmartStudyPlan.title: Smart Study Plan
SmartStudyPlan.description: Persisted multi-subject study planner preferences and background-computed schedule blocks keyed strictly by Firebase Auth UID.

ExamQuestion.title: Categorized Exam Question
ExamQuestion.description: Categorized exam simulation question bank entry queryable by topic and difficulty.
